MOD_VAL = 1000000007

if k_value_input == 0:
    total_product = 1
    for _ in range(1, p_value_input):
        total_product = (total_product * p_value_input) % MOD_VAL
    print(total_product)
else:
    sequence_array = [0] * p_value_input
    visited_array = [False] * p_value_input

    for i in range(1, p_value_input):
        sequence_array[i] = (k_value_input * i) % p_value_input

    final_ans = 1
    for start_idx in range(p_value_input):
        if not visited_array[start_idx]:
            cycle_length = 0
            current_idx = start_idx
            product_mod = 1
            while not visited_array[current_idx]:
                visited_array[current_idx] = True
                current_idx = sequence_array[current_idx]
                cycle_length += 1
                product_mod = (product_mod * k_value_input) % p_value_input
            if cycle_length == 1:
                factor = p_value_input if k_value_input == 1 else 1
                final_ans = (final_ans * factor) % MOD_VAL
            else:
                assert product_mod == 1
                final_ans = (final_ans * p_value_input) % MOD_VAL
    print(final_ans)
